Y = Emax / Vmin		 10000 15000 20000 10000 15000 20000
Ratio of minimum dead load output return (1)
Z = Emax / (2 * DR)		 4200 6000 7000 3300 4400 5500
Input impedance 406 Ω ± 6 Ω
Temperature range -10 °C / + 40 °C
Fraction pLC 0,7
Humidity Class CH

Excitation maximum 18 V AC / DC
Transducer material Alluminium alloy
Atmospheric protection Silicon rubber
